name: aws-auth
description: Serve Bedrock-scoped AWS credentials to the jail from a host SSO session, minted per profile and narrowed before they cross.

profile.description: the AWS profile this service resolves (the one you `aws sso login --profile`). Absent: the service serves nothing, and the launch says to set this key

role_arn.description: a role to assume before serving, so the jail holds that role's permissions rather than the whole permission set

session_policy.description: an inline IAM session policy (JSON) attached to that AssumeRole, narrowing inside Bedrock. Needs role_arn; checked for parseability at spawn

unnarrowed.description: serve the configured profile's permission set as-is, without an additional AssumeRole or session policy

inherit_from_parent_jail.disclose: the nested jail uses this jail's own Bedrock credentials (narrowed by the host; no daemon started)
